title: Polycomb repression of Hox genes involves spatial feedback but not domain compaction or phase transition.
authors: Murphy, Sedona Eve; Boettiger, Alistair Nicol
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光学成像与聚合物模拟研究Polycomb对Hox基因的沉默机制，涉及染色质空间组织与表观遗传反馈，但核心是染色质折叠而非TF-DNA结合互作，方法上仅用聚合物模拟，与课题的TF-DNA结合建模关联有限。
abstract: Polycomb group proteins have a critical role in silencing transcription during development. It is commonly proposed that Polycomb-dependent changes in genome folding, which compact chromatin, contribute directly to repression by blocking the binding of activating complexes. Recently, it has also been argued that liquid-liquid demixing of Polycomb proteins facilitates this compaction and repression by phase-separating target genes into a membraneless compartment. To test these models, we used Optical Reconstruction of Chromatin Architecture to trace the Hoxa gene cluster, a canonical Polycomb target, in thousands of single cells. Across multiple cell types, we find that Polycomb-bound chromatin frequently explores decompact states and partial mixing with neighboring chromatin, while remaining uniformly repressed, challenging the repression-by-compaction or phase-separation models. Using polymer simulations, we show that these observed flexible ensembles can be explained by 'spatial feedback'-transient contacts that contribute to the propagation of the epigenetic state (epigenetic memory), without inducing a globular organization.
abstract_zh: Polycomb 群蛋白在发育过程中对转录沉默具有关键作用。普遍认为，Polycomb 依赖的基因组折叠变化（使染色质压缩）通过阻断激活复合物的结合，直接促进抑制。最近，也有观点提出，Polycomb 蛋白的液-液相分离通过将靶基因相分离到无膜区室中，促进这种压缩和抑制。为检验这些模型，我们使用染色质结构光学重建技术，追踪了经典 Polycomb 靶标 Hoxa 基因簇在数千个单细胞中的情况。在多种细胞类型中，我们发现 Polycomb 结合的染色质频繁探索去压缩状态，并与邻近染色质发生部分混合，同时保持均匀抑制，这对压缩-抑制或相分离模型提出了挑战。通过聚合物模拟，我们表明这些观察到的柔性集合可通过“空间反馈”解释——即瞬时接触有助于表观遗传状态（表观遗传记忆）的传播，而不诱导球状组织。
